description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides an API client for the Traffic Insights frontend. It includes functions to fetch live traffic data, historical traffic data, and traffic predictions by making HTTP requests to a backend server. The functions handle constructing URLs based on environment variables, appending query parameters, and parsing JSON responses while handling errors.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base URL for API requests by resolving environment variables and window location fallback.

methods.name: safeFetchJson(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to a constructed URL, handles response status, content type, and errors, returning parsed JSON or text.

methods.name: appendCity(path, city)
methods.description: Appends a city query parameter to a URL path if a city is provided.

methods.name: fetchLiveTraffic(city)
methods.description: Fetches latest live traffic snapshot, optionally filtered by city.

methods.name: fetchTrafficHistory(from, to, city)
methods.description: Fetches historical aggregated traffic data between two timestamps, optionally filtered by city.

methods.name: fetchTrafficPrediction(horizonMinutes = 15, city)
methods.description: Fetches short-term traffic predictions with a specified horizon, optionally filtered by city.
